verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Agent Flows and custom skills that extend what the in-chat agent can do, and those run when a user starts an @agent chat session. Nothing shows user-configured automations that run on a schedule, a trigger, or unattended in the background. The automatic meeting transcription is a fixed built-in feature, not a user-defined automation, so it is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
